pagetitle: "About"

The Centre for Household Finance is a research group in the
[Department of Economics](https://www.ekon.sun.ac.za) at
[Stellenbosch University](https://www.sun.ac.za).

We use the tools of applied microeconomics to study how households make
financial decisions and what shapes the choices they make. To do this, we
seek out survey and administrative data from sources in the public and private
sectors. The [Research](../research/index.qmd) page describes our current work
and lists our papers.

## Governance

The Centre operates under a constitution approved by the Faculty and a Research
Charter that governs research independence, data governance, and our
relationships with funders and data partners. Both are published in full on the
[Governance](governance.qmd) page.
